'''{{PAGENAME}}''' was a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|How's it going my friend! Not cold, are you? Well, here's the thing... We're going to arrange a feast with our comrades-in-arms at the base, it's Christmas after all! But you know how it is in inventory warehouses. According to the records everything is there, but in reality there's only tushonka and a shitload of potatoes. We wanted to make olivier salad, maybe two bowls. Amd we need some booze, too. Can you get it? Just don't bring the potatoes, we have enough of it.}}

==Objectives==
* Hand over 5 [[Salty Dog beef sausage]]
* Hand over 5 [[Can of green peas]]
* Hand over 5 [[Jar of DevilDog mayo]]
* Hand over 1 [[Bottle of Tarkovskaya vodka]]
* Hand over 1 [[Bottle of Dan Jackiel whiskey]]
* Hand over 3 [[Jar of pickles]]

==Rewards==
* +18,800 [[EXP]]
* [[Prapor]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.03'''</font>
* 200,000 Roubles
** 210,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 1
** 230,000 Roubles with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence center]] Level 2
* 3× [[AK-74 5.45x39 6L31 60-round magazine]]
* 2× [[AK Zenit B-10M handguard with B-19 upper mount]]
* 2× [[AK-12 5.45x39 30-round magazine]]
* 2× [[AK Zenit RK-3 pistol grip]]
* 2× [[SKS Hexagon 7.62x39 sound suppressor]]
{{quote|Well done! Oh and yeah, I can't invite you too, sorry. It's for old acquaintances, officers and stuff, you know? But you do deserve the reward for procuring the resources, so here you go.}}
